name: provenance-lens-public
description: Credential-free public source edition of the Provenance Lens Chromium extension.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @provenance-lens/shared && npm run dev --workspace @provenance-lens/extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run build --workspace @provenance-lens/shared && npm run build --workspace @provenance-lens/extension
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @provenance-lens/shared && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && npm run test --workspace @provenance-lens/extension && npm run test:launcher
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:extension && npm run test:e2e --workspace @provenance-lens/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @provenance-lens/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.package:public: npm run build:extension && node scripts/audit-extension.mjs && node scripts/scan-extension.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs
